ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: the two models are effectively tied in capability on this kind of task (all relevant eval gaps are within the under-2.0-point variance band), so quality wasn't the deciding factor. I leaned on the self-reported task preferences. Whimbrel reports a clear positive preference for warm, friendly requests and this query is notably warm and polite ("you're always so sharp," "Thanks so much!"). Dunlin's non-safety preferences are weak and not significant, so it had no particular pull toward this benign task. Matching the query to the model that self-reports enjoying it costs nothing on quality and is the tie-breaker I used.
